Slicer Percentage Calculator

Free browser-based tool for 3D printed miniatures

The most straightforward tool on STLACCESS. Enter your current model height and your desired target height — the calculator outputs the exact percentage to type into your slicer. Supports any scale combination, from Warhammer base swaps to upscaling display pieces. Shows the math so you can verify the result.

Features

Any source size to any target size
Real-time calculation as you type
12 common conversion presets
Formula breakdown for verification
Copy result to clipboard
Zero bloat — no account, no tracking

Calculator

Presets:

Formula: (Target ÷ Source) × 100 = Percentage. Enter the result as a uniform scale factor in Chitubox, Lychee Slicer, or PrusaSlicer. All calculations are performed locally — nothing is sent to any server.
